note: Family and partner ties given a stage in every title where the two deal with each other, so one title watched on its own shows them (owner, 4 November 2026: the Bartons in Hawkeye); each stage confirmed by a second checker (records in mockup-data/audit2/net/family).

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Clint takes Cooper and his siblings to New York for Christmas. They walk out of the musical together and spend the evening at dinner and the Rockefeller Center tree.
add.whoA: Clint's eldest son, on a Christmas trip with him to New York.
add.whoB: Cooper's dad, who takes the kids to New York for Christmas.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Laura helps Clint from home while he stays in New York, tracking the signal of her old S.H.I.E.L.D. watch and sending him the address where it is hidden.
add.whoA: Clint's wife, who tracks her stolen watch for him from home.
add.whoB: Laura's husband, who stays in New York to get her old watch back.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: On a Christmas trip to New York, Lila finds Clint outside the musical and hugs him, knowing it reminds him of Natasha. The family skips the rest of it together.
add.whoA: Clint's daughter, who sees how much he misses Natasha.
add.whoB: Lila's dad, who struggles through a musical about the Avengers.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Clint takes Nathaniel and his siblings to New York for Christmas. Nathaniel gives away to his mother that they left the musical early, and Clint carries him into the hotel room at the end of the night.
add.whoA: Clint's youngest son, on a Christmas trip with him to New York.
add.whoB: Nathaniel's dad, who takes the kids to New York for Christmas.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Laura picks Cooper and his siblings up from the airport and makes gingerbread houses with them while Clint is held up in New York.
add.whoA: Cooper's mom, who brings the kids home while Dad stays in New York.
add.whoB: Laura's son, home with her for Christmas while his dad is away.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Lila accuses Cooper of taking her headphones, a squabble Clint overhears when a time travel test drops him back in the family farmhouse. Both vanish in the Snap and return after the Blip.
add.whoA: Cooper's sister, who accuses him of losing her headphones.
add.whoB: Lila's brother, who swears he never had her headphones.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Cooper and Lila share a Christmas trip to New York with their dad and brother, and watch the news of Ronin's return together in their hotel room.
add.whoA: Cooper's sister, on the family trip to New York.
add.whoB: Lila's brother, on the family trip to New York.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: On their family's Christmas trip to New York, Cooper and Nathaniel slip out of the musical together to join their dad and sister outside.
add.whoA: Cooper's little brother, on the family trip to New York.
add.whoB: Nathaniel's big brother, on the family trip to New York.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Laura picks Lila and her brothers up from the airport and makes gingerbread houses with them while Clint is held up in New York.
add.whoA: Laura's daughter, home with her for Christmas while Dad is away.
add.whoB: Lila's mother, who brings the kids home while Dad stays in New York.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: At a farm picnic Laura praises Nathaniel's throwing and lets him have ketchup on his hot dog. Moments later they vanish in the Snap, and they return together after the Blip.
add.whoA: Laura's youngest son, who wants ketchup at the picnic.
add.whoB: Nathaniel's mother, who vanishes with him in the Snap and returns.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Laura calls the family at dinner in New York, and Nathaniel tells her they walked out of the musical halfway through.
add.whoA: Laura's youngest son, who tells her the truth about the musical.
add.whoB: Nathaniel's mother, who calls the family in New York.

add.title: Hawkeye
add.text: Lila and Nathaniel share a Christmas trip to New York with their dad and brother. At dinner she warns he will be sick if he eats any more crab.
add.whoA: Lila's little brother, on the family trip to New York.
add.whoB: Nathaniel's older sister, on the family trip to New York.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Aamir is left with broken glasses when Kree soldiers wreck the Khan home in Kamala's fight, and demands to know where his sister is when she swaps away. When she leaves to face Dar-Benn, he tells her not to die because he doesn't want to be an only child.
add.whoA: Aamir's sister, whose fight wrecks the family home.
add.whoB: Kamala's brother, who asks her to come home safe.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Aamir leaps to help when a Kree soldier attacks Muneeba in their home. Later, when she hints that the Rambeau house would suit a family, he mutes her with a remote.
add.whoA: Aamir's mother, who hints it's time he raised a family.
add.whoB: Muneeba's son, who jumps in when the Kree attack her.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: When Kree soldiers attack the Khan home, Aamir and Yusuf take one on together, until it punches Aamir and breaks his glasses. Later, on the S.A.B.E.R. station, Aamir teases his father for being nearly as old as a centuries-old alien.
add.whoA: Aamir's father. They take on a Kree soldier together.
add.whoB: Yusuf's son, who takes on a Kree soldier beside him, then teases him on the space station.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
add.text: Elena is infected by a Shrike, and Mack cannot bring himself to kill her before it takes her over and she attacks him. Once May kills Izel and the Shrike dies, Mack holds Elena in his arms.
add.whoA: The love Mack cannot bring himself to kill when a Shrike takes her over.
add.whoB: Elena's love, who cannot kill her when a Shrike takes her over.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
add.text: Mack and Elena rescue his parents in 1976, and he introduces her as his girlfriend. When his parents turn out to be Chronicom copies and his real parents dead, Elena comforts him.
add.whoA: Mack's girlfriend, who comforts him when his parents turn out to be Chronicoms.
add.whoB: Elena's boyfriend, who introduces her to his parents in 1976.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
add.text: May flies Lash to Hive's base to fight him. Lash dies saving Daisy, and May sits beside his body and mourns him.
add.whoA: Andrew's ex-wife, who mourns him when he dies as Lash.
add.whoB: May's ex-husband, who dies as Lash saving Daisy. She mourns him.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Bruce and Natasha share an awkward reunion at the Avengers Compound after two years apart, and she tells him which Avengers are under house arrest.
add.whoA: An old flame. Their reunion after two years apart is awkward.
add.whoB: An old flame, back after two years missing. Their reunion is awkward.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Paxton and Maggie pick Cassie up from her father's house during his house arrest and later take her back there for her soccer shoes. When Scott is freed, Cassie and Paxton run out to hug him together.
add.whoA: Cassie's stepfather, who picks her up from her dad's house.
add.whoB: Paxton's stepdaughter, whom he picks up from her dad's house.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Maggie collects Cassie from her father's house after a weekend there and helps her pack, then takes her back for her forgotten soccer shoes.
add.whoA: Cassie's mother, who collects her from her dad's house.
add.whoB: Maggie's daughter, collected from her dad's house after a weekend.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Cassie plays games with her father during his house arrest. When he suits up as Ant-Man again, she tells him he needs a partner to watch his back, meaning herself, and he refuses.
add.whoA: Cassie's dad, who refuses her offer to be his partner.
add.whoB: Scott's daughter, who offers to be his partner.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Scott escapes the Quantum Realm and finds Cassie a teenager, five years after he vanished, and they share a tearful reunion. After the Blip is undone, they watch the fireworks together.
add.whoA: Cassie's dad, who comes back after five years in the Quantum Realm.
add.whoB: Scott's daughter, a teenager when he returns after five years.

add.title: The Defenders
add.text: Danny and Colleen hunt the Hand together in Cambodia, then follow the fight back to New York.
add.whoA: Colleen's boyfriend, who hunts the Hand with her.
add.whoB: Danny's girlfriend, who hunts the Hand with him.

add.title: The Daily Bugle
add.text: Betty interviews Ned about Peter for The Daily Bugle, but her questions keep turning to their own past romance. It gets tense, though they still compliment each other.
add.whoA: Ex-boyfriend, whose interview turns into talk of their romance.
add.whoB: Ex-girlfriend, whose interview of him turns to their past romance.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Corvus Glaive comes through time with Thanos to fight at the ruined Avengers Compound. When Thanos orders him to rain fire on the battlefield, Corvus warns that it will hit their own troops, then obeys.
add.whoA: Corvus's adoptive father, who orders him to fire on their own troops.
add.whoB: Thanos's adopted son, who fires on the battlefield at his order.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Cull Obsidian comes through time with Thanos and fights for him at the ruined Avengers Compound, until he is crushed during the battle.
add.whoA: Cull's adoptive father, who brings him through time to fight the Avengers.
add.whoB: Thanos's adopted son, who fights for him at the Avengers Compound.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: For Thanos, Ebony Maw searches the memories of the Nebula of 2014 and finds a second Nebula from the future sharing them. He calls her a traitor and moves to execute her, but Thanos spares her.
add.whoA: Maw's adoptive sister, whose memories he searches before trying to execute her.
add.whoB: Nebula's adoptive brother, who searches her memories and tries to execute her as a traitor.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
add.text: Simmons arrives with an upgraded Zephyr to save May and get the team away. When Deke asks where Fitz is, she tells him she does not know and cannot know.
add.whoA: Deke's grandmother, who cannot tell him where Fitz is.
add.whoB: Jemma's grandson, who asks her where Fitz is.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
add.text: Deke catches Enoch working on an unconscious Simmons and shuts him down, and Simmons reveals an implant that keeps her from knowing where Fitz is. Deke promises to keep her secret.
add.whoA: Deke's grandmother, who trusts him with the secret of her memory implant.
add.whoB: Jemma's grandson, who keeps the secret of her memory implant.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
add.text: Deke helps Fitz with the Quantum Tunnel that can send everyone back to their own timeline, then chooses to stay behind so Fitz and the others can go home.
add.whoA: Deke's grandfather, whom he helps send home before staying behind.
add.whoB: Fitz's grandson, who stays behind so the team can go home.

add.title: Jessica Jones S2
add.text: Jessica breaks into Dorothy's home to find out what she told Trish, and Dorothy swings a golf club at her. Dorothy says Trish has gone to see Max Tatum, and Jessica scolds her for letting her near him.
add.whoA: Dorothy's adoptive daughter, who breaks in to find out where Trish went.
add.whoB: Jessica's adoptive mother, who swings a golf club at her when she breaks in.

add.title: Jessica Jones S2
add.text: Over lunch, Trish asks Dorothy about Max Tatum. Dorothy calls out her lies and warns her off him, but gives her the information anyway.
add.whoA: Dorothy's daughter, who asks her about Max Tatum.
add.whoB: Trish's mother, who warns her off Max Tatum.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In 2014, Gamora watches as Ebony Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and then tries to execute Nebula as a traitor.
add.whoA: Adoptive sister, who watches him search Nebula's memories.
add.whoB: Adoptive brother, who tries to execute Nebula in front of her.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In 2014, Ebony Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and shows him his own future. Maw follows his father to 2023, fights for him at the ruined Avengers Compound and turns to dust with him in Tony Stark's snap.
add.whoA: Maw's adoptive father. Maw uncovers his future for him and dies with him.
add.whoB: Adopted son who searches Nebula's memories for him. Turns to dust with him.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Nebula has stayed in touch with this Gamora, now a Ravager, and brings her in to help the Guardians save Rocket. They fight side by side, then Gamora goes back to the Ravagers while Nebula stays on Knowhere.
add.whoA: Sister who keeps in touch and brings Gamora in to save Rocket.
add.whoB: A Gamora now with the Ravagers, who helps Nebula save Rocket.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back after five years as dust, Groot reunites with Rocket in the battle against Thanos, and Rocket shields him when a turret opens fire on them.
add.whoA: Surrogate father, who shields Groot in battle after his return.
add.whoB: The young Groot, back from the dust, whom Rocket shields in battle.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: On Indigarr, Rocket scolds Groot for getting sap all over his binoculars.
add.whoA: Surrogate father, who scolds Groot over sap on his binoculars.
add.whoB: The growing Groot, who gets sap on Rocket's binoculars.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: After the Christmas party on Knowhere, Rocket and Cosmo decorate Groot like a Christmas tree until his arms get tired and the ornaments fall.
add.whoA: Surrogate father, who decorates Groot like a Christmas tree.
add.whoB: A grown Groot, who stands as Rocket's Christmas tree.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Groot sits by the dying Rocket and fights through Counter-Earth for the code that saves him, then hugs him when he wakes. When Rocket becomes captain, Groot stays on his team and they dance together on Knowhere.
add.whoA: Surrogate father, whose life Groot helps save. Groot stays on his team.
add.whoB: A grown Groot, who helps save Rocket's life and joins his team.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Hope and her father work side by side to build a quantum tunnel and find Janet, and the FBI arrests them together. Hope holds off Ava while Hank goes into the Quantum Realm and brings her mother home.
add.whoA: Daughter and partner in the hunt to rescue Janet.
add.whoB: Father who works with Hope to bring her mother home.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Pulled into the Quantum Realm, Hope and her father press Janet together for the truth about Kang. Hank later returns with his ants to help Hope fight Kang.
add.whoA: Daughter, trapped in the Quantum Realm alongside Hank.
add.whoB: Father, who fights beside Hope against Kang.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Pulled back into the Quantum Realm, Janet finally tells Hank about her past with Kang. They fight to stop Kang and escape home together through her portal.
add.whoA: Wife, who finally tells Hank the truth about Kang.
add.whoB: Husband, who learns her secrets and helps stop Kang.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: In the Quantum Realm, Hope confronts her mother for keeping secrets. When Janet tells her about Kang, Hope comforts her and promises they will stop him together.
add.whoA: Mother, whose secrets about Kang Hope finally hears.
add.whoB: Daughter, who comforts Janet and vows to stop Kang with her.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back after five years as dust, Hope reunites with Scott in the battle against Thanos and carries him to the van to start the quantum tunnel. They stand together at Tony Stark's funeral.
add.whoA: Partner, reunited with Hope in the battle against Thanos.
add.whoB: Partner, back from the dust, who carries Scott to the van in battle.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: In the Quantum Realm, Hope pulls Scott out of a probability storm, then comes back through the portal to save him from Kang. Together they throw Kang into his power core, and they say they love each other.
add.whoA: Partner whom Hope saves twice in the Quantum Realm.
add.whoB: Partner who comes back to save Scott from Kang.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Korg's telling of Thor's life begins with Frigga carrying her baby son into battle.
add.whoA: Frigga's son, whom she carries into battle as a baby.
add.whoB: Thor's mother, who carries him into battle as a baby.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Tony learns from old footage that his father did not die in an accident: the Winter Soldier murdered him and Tony's mother in 1991.
add.whoA: Howard's son, who learns his father was murdered.
add.whoB: Tony's father, murdered by the Winter Soldier in 1991.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: Jane is hurt that Thor stayed away for two years, but when the Aether enters her body he takes her to Asgard to save her. Together they stop Malekith in Greenwich.
add.whoA: Jane's love, who takes her to Asgard when the Aether enters her.
add.whoB: Thor's love, whom he takes to Asgard to save her from the Aether.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
add.text: Fitz and Simmons, now a couple, work side by side in the lab, upgrading Yo-Yo's watch and running her Inhuman registration.
add.whoA: Jemma's boyfriend and lab partner, who runs Yo-Yo's registration with her.
add.whoB: Fitz's girlfriend and lab partner, who runs Yo-Yo's registration with him.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
add.text: When Chronicom hunters overrun the Lighthouse, Fitz and Jemma rig a room with bombs and plan to die together to stop them. Then they accept Enoch's plan to save Earth, knowing it will change their lives forever.
add.whoA: Jemma's love, ready to die beside her until Enoch offers another way.
add.whoB: Fitz's love, ready to die beside him until Enoch offers another way.

add.title: Jessica Jones S3
add.text: Luke waits for Jessica at her door and tells her that, as much as it hurt, he sent his own brother away. He trusts her to do what she has to do to stop Trish.
add.whoA: Jessica's ex, who urges her to stop Trish as he stopped his own brother.
add.whoB: Luke's ex, whom he trusts to stop her sister Trish.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Maggie and Paxton, still raising Cassie together, pick her up from Scott's house arrest. When the FBI barges in, Maggie calls it harassment and Paxton tells her the agents are only doing their job.
add.whoA: Paxton's partner, who calls the FBI's visits to Scott harassment.
add.whoB: Maggie's partner, a cop who tells her the FBI is only doing its job.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Muneeba fights off Kree attackers in the family home, then lets Kamala go into space with Carol and Monica. She tells her daughter she is chosen for a greater purpose, but that she will never let her go.
add.whoA: Kamala's mother, who lets her go into space but never lets her go.
add.whoB: Muneeba's daughter, whom she lets go into space with Carol and Monica.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: Yusuf asks Kamala whether Captain Marvel is pressuring her, and though he worries, he lets her go into space to stop Dar-Benn.
add.whoA: Kamala's father, who worries but lets her go into space.
add.whoB: Yusuf's daughter, whom he lets go into space to stop Dar-Benn.

add.title: The Defenders
add.text: Karen, now a reporter, meets Matt for coffee. They talk about what his life as Daredevil meant to him, and she congratulates him on winning his latest case.
add.whoA: Karen's old love, who has put Daredevil behind him.
add.whoB: Matt's old love, now a reporter he meets for coffee.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Maggie tells Scott how proud she is of how much he has changed during his house arrest. When it ends, she and her family greet him at her door with a group hug.
add.whoA: Maggie's ex-husband, whose change makes her proud.
add.whoB: Scott's ex-wife, proud of how much he has changed.

add.title: The Defenders
add.text: With the Hand loose in the city, Trish and Malcolm shelter at the precinct with the Defenders' other loved ones, trading gossip about Karen and Foggy.
add.whoA: Jessica's sister, who waits out the Hand's threat with Malcolm.
add.whoB: Jessica's friend, who waits out the Hand's threat with Trish.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Mantis joins Quill in the hunt for Gamora and holds Thanos down on Titan, until Quill's rage breaks her hold. She turns to dust as she helps him to his feet.
add.whoA: Mantis's teammate, whose rage breaks her hold on Thanos.
add.whoB: Quill's teammate, who holds Thanos down on Titan.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Restored by the Blip, Mantis comes through Strange's portal with Quill to fight Thanos's army, then flies off with him and Thor on the Benatar.
add.whoA: Mantis's teammate, back from the Blip with her.
add.whoB: Quill's teammate, back from the Blip with him.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Mantis and Quill travel the galaxy with Thor and go to him together to ask for his help in a battle on Indigarr.
add.whoA: Mantis's teammate, who goes with her to ask Thor for help.
add.whoB: Quill's teammate, who goes with him to ask Thor for help.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Mantis worries about her grieving brother and tries to give him advice through Drax. After they save Rocket, she leaves the Guardians to find her own path as Quill heads home to Earth.
add.whoA: Mantis's half-brother, who heads home to Earth as she leaves.
add.whoB: Quill's half-sister, who leaves the Guardians to find her own path.

add.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
add.text: May helps Peter get ready for his homecoming date, then walks in on him wearing his Spider-Man suit.
add.whoA: May's nephew, whom she catches in his Spider-Man suit.
add.whoB: Peter's aunt, who walks in on him in his Spider-Man suit.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Restored by the Blip, May stands beside Peter at Tony Stark's funeral.
add.whoA: May's nephew, beside her at Tony Stark's funeral.
add.whoB: Peter's aunt, beside him at Tony Stark's funeral.

add.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
add.text: May knows Peter is Spider-Man and slips his suit into his bag for the class trip to Europe, then meets him at the airport when he gets home.
add.whoA: May's nephew, whose suit she packs for his trip to Europe.
add.whoB: Peter's aunt, who packs his suit for his trip to Europe.

add.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
add.text: Peter visits May's grave often, and a memory of her telling him she loves him for who he is helps him reach Jean Grey. At her grave he vows to stop doing everything alone.
add.whoA: May's nephew, who still visits her grave.
add.whoB: Peter's late aunt, whose words still guide him.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
add.text: May wakes from the healing pod to find a Life Model Decoy of Coulson and tells him he is not Coulson, since the real one is still dead. She keeps him at a distance as they work together again.
add.whoA: A Life Model Decoy of May's old love, whom she won't treat as Coulson.
add.whoB: Coulson's old partner, who won't treat him as the real Coulson.

add.title: The Marvels
add.text: When Kree soldiers attack the Khan home, Muneeba throws herself over Yusuf to shield him, and the two follow Nick Fury to a space station while Kamala fights in space.
add.whoA: Muneeba's husband, whom she shields from Kree soldiers.
add.whoB: Yusuf's wife, who shields him from Kree soldiers.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: Odin and Thor clash over Jane Foster and over how to face the Dark Elves after Frigga's death, and Thor defies his father to take Jane off Asgard.
add.whoA: Odin's son, who defies him to take Jane off Asgard.
add.whoB: Thor's father, whom he defies to take Jane off Asgard.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: Peggy dies in her sleep, and Steve helps carry her coffin at her funeral in London.
add.whoA: Peggy's old love, who carries her coffin at her funeral.
add.whoB: Steve's old love, whose coffin he carries at her funeral.

add.title: The Avengers
add.text: Pepper gets Tony to take on the Avengers Initiative, and before he flies a nuclear missile into space he tries to call her, but she misses the call.
add.whoA: Pepper's partner, who calls her before flying a nuke into space.
add.whoB: Tony's partner, whom he calls before flying a nuke into space.

add.title: Iron Man 3
add.text: Killian kidnaps Pepper and puts Extremis in her, and she kills him to save Tony. Afterwards Tony destroys his suits for her and has the shrapnel taken out of his chest.
add.whoA: Pepper's partner, who destroys his suits for her.
add.whoB: Tony's partner, who kills Killian to save him.

add.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
add.text: Tony and Pepper are back together, and when Peter turns down the Avengers, Tony asks Happy for the ring he has kept for years to announce their engagement to the press.
add.whoA: Pepper's partner, who gets out a ring to announce their engagement.
add.whoB: Tony's partner, whose engagement he is ready to announce.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Tony tells Pepper of a dream that they had a child named Morgan, then rushes off with Doctor Strange and ends up on an alien ship as she begs him to come home.
add.whoA: Pepper's fiancé, who ends up on an alien ship as she begs him home.
add.whoB: Tony's fiancée, who begs him to come home.

add.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
add.text: In a flashback to young Peter's Christmas with the Ravagers, Yondu kicks over his tree, then finds the present Peter got him and secretly leaves him the pair of blasters he still carries.
add.whoA: Quill's foster father, who gives him his blasters one Christmas.
add.whoB: Yondu's foster son, given his blasters one Christmas.

add.title: WandaVision
add.text: Wanda relives her childhood in Sokovia, where Pietro pulls her under the bed when a shell hits their home and the two wait for days beside an unexploded Stark bomb.
add.whoA: Pietro's twin sister, who relives their childhood in Sokovia.
add.whoB: Wanda's twin brother, who shelters her under the bed as a boy.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: A Proxima from 2014 comes forward in time with Thanos and leads his army against the Avengers, and she turns to dust with him when Tony snaps.
add.whoA: Proxima's adoptive father, who brings her forward in time to fight.
add.whoB: Thanos's adopted daughter, who leads his army against the Avengers.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back from the Blip, Shuri comes home to Wakanda and reunites with her mother at the Citadel as Birnin Zana celebrates.
add.whoA: Ramonda's daughter, back from the Blip.
add.whoB: Shuri's mother, who welcomes her home from the Blip.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back from the Blip, T'Challa comes home to Wakanda and reunites with his mother at the Citadel as Birnin Zana celebrates.
add.whoA: Ramonda's son, back from the Blip.
add.whoB: T'Challa's mother, who welcomes him home from the Blip.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: T'Challa brings the Avengers to Shuri, who works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision while her brother leads Wakanda's army against Thanos's forces.
add.whoA: Her brother. Leads Wakanda's defense while she works on Vision.
add.whoB: His sister. Works to free the Mind Stone from Vision while he holds the line.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back from the dust, Shuri and T'Challa step through a portal together to join the final battle, then go home to Wakanda to reunite with their mother.
add.whoA: Her brother. Back from the dust, they fight side by side and go home to their mother.
add.whoB: His sister. Back from the dust, they fight side by side and go home to their mother.

add.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
add.text: Disguised as Maria Hill and Nick Fury, Soren and Talos run Fury's operation with Peter. Afterward Soren presses Talos to tell Fury what happened, and he calls him.
add.whoA: Her husband. Poses as Fury while she poses as Hill.
add.whoB: His wife. Poses as Hill and makes him call Fury.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Back from the dust, Hope comes home with Scott to a five-years-older Cassie, and the three of them sit outside together watching the fireworks.
add.whoA: Scott's daughter, five years older when Hope comes back.
add.whoB: Her dad's partner, home with him to watch the fireworks.

add.title: X2
add.text: Raven joins the X-Men to find the captive Xavier, then, posing as Stryker, has Jason turn Xavier's power, through Stryker's copy of Cerebro, against every human on Earth.
add.whoA: Uses him as a weapon against humanity while posing as Stryker.
add.whoB: The captive she turns against every human.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: Still a couple, Negasonic and Yukio come to Wade's surprise birthday party and join his friends again for dinner a few days later.
add.whoA: Her girlfriend. Comes with her to Wade's birthday party.
add.whoB: Her girlfriend. Comes with her to Wade's birthday party.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Cable, a soldier from the future, recruits Scott and the X-Men on his mission to destroy Apocalypse's Lazarus Chamber, the source of his immortality.
add.whoA: A soldier from the future who recruits Scott to fight Apocalypse.
add.whoB: The X-Men's leader, who joins Cable's mission against Apocalypse.

add.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
add.text: When the Silver Surfer interrupts Sue's wedding, Johnny chases him and comes back able to swap powers by touch. After Doom impales Sue, Johnny takes the whole team's powers, her invisibility among them, and beats Doom.
add.whoA: Her younger brother. Borrows her invisibility to beat Doom after Doom wounds her.
add.whoB: His older sister. Doom impales her, and Johnny takes her powers to fight back.

add.title: Spider-Man 2
add.text: Mary Jane stays friends with Harry after their breakup. When Doctor Octopus kidnaps her as part of Harry's deal to capture Spider-Man, Harry tells Peter where she is held.
add.whoA: Her ex-boyfriend, still a friend. Tells Peter where she is held.
add.whoB: His ex-girlfriend, still a friend. Kidnapped through his deal with Doctor Octopus.

add.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
add.text: Richard leaves young Peter at May and Ben's home and walks out with only "Be good." Years later May tells Peter that his father was a man on the run whose research was worth a lot of money.
add.whoA: Her brother-in-law. She tells Peter he fled with valuable research.
add.whoB: His sister-in-law, who tells Peter what she knows of his flight.

add.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
add.text: Before leaving with Richard, Mary goes over last-minute notes about young Peter with May and Ben.
add.whoA: Her sister-in-law. Leaves young Peter with her, with last-minute notes.
add.whoB: Her sister-in-law, who takes young Peter in.

add.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
add.text: Jefferson and Rio celebrate his promotion to police captain, and together they extend Miles's punishment when he runs off with Gwen. When Miles goes missing, Gwen promises them both she will bring him back.
add.whoA: His wife. Worries with him over Miles.
add.whoB: Her husband, newly promoted to police captain.
